name: valve_ep2_nest_chambers
note: Episode Two's antlion nest, the big cave of ep2_outland_04 (box x 1504 to 3520, y -3712 to -1224, z -2560 to -1024; every brush whose corners' mean is inside, and 875158, 875390, 875440: S1's west wall): a domed cave of Valve's own rock (blendrockslime02a, blendrockdirt_tunnel03a, web antlion_web01a), floors -1855 to -1975, its dome 390 to 620 over them, nests hung upside down on it (nest_lrg_flat 30, nest_med_flat 18), web sacks, stalactites, two pits (Valve's are bottomless: here cut at -2560), the south room and the guard's hiding hole. Ways in: S1, the south corridor (y -3712, x 2648 to 2888, floor -1975, 240 wide, 192 high, sloping 17 degrees down outward) and N1, the north-east tunnel (y -1224, x 2544 to 2832, floor -1860, 288 by 388); N2 (a crawl 72 wide on the north face) and the dome's chimney are to be capped. Its tunnels run on past the box (displaced rock up to 144 past the south face, 120 past the north): caps of 160 and 128 there. Anchor: S1's middle on its floor. Measured 21 November (the helper's report: no pictures).
